forms.pitch: A dynamic weather system that makes the {setting.noun} wetter, windier and far more dramatic.
forms.connects: Storms decide when and where you can find {resource.noun}.

forms.pitch: Everyone {setting.in} remembers what you did, and they talk about it.
forms.connects: Good standing makes {resource.noun} cheaper; bad standing makes {threat.noun} personal.

forms.pitch: A sprawling crafting tree with 140 recipes, eleven of which are useful.
forms.connects: Every recipe eats {resource.noun}, so crafting and scavenging finally feed each other.

forms.pitch: A full day-night cycle in which the night belongs to {threat.noun}.
forms.connects: Night trips for {resource.noun} become high-risk, high-reward gambles.

forms.pitch: A loyal companion who comments on everything, helps with {mechanic.noun} and occasionally falls into things.
forms.connects: A second pair of hands makes {mechanic.noun} deeper without making it harder.

forms.pitch: A fully simulated player economy where the price of {resource.noun} rises and falls with supply, demand and rumours.
forms.connects: Hoarding {resource.noun} becomes a strategy, and so does crashing the market on purpose.

forms.pitch: Let players build a home base {setting.in}, one unnecessary room at a time.
forms.connects: The base stores {resource.noun} and gives you somewhere to hide from {threat.noun}.

forms.pitch: A relationship system where you can befriend, romance or deeply annoy everyone you meet.
forms.connects: Friends share {resource.noun}; rivals sabotage your plans to {objective.verb}.

forms.pitch: A detailed injury system that remembers every bruise your {protagonist.noun} has ever collected.
forms.connects: Injuries change how {mechanic.noun} plays, so caution finally matters.

forms.pitch: Hunger, thirst and sleep meters, because surviving should feel like a part-time job.
forms.connects: Basic needs compete with your hunt for {resource.noun}.

forms.pitch: Three factions {setting.in}, each with its own agenda and a shared dislike of you.
forms.connects: Every faction wants {resource.noun}, and each has a different answer to {threat.noun}.

forms.pitch: Give the enemy side its own skill tree: {threat.noun}, now with perks.

scopeNote.text: One {setting.noun}, one mechanic ({mechanic.noun}), a ten-minute run. Cut everything else.
Build {mechanic.noun} and {threat.noun}, nothing more, and ship it in 48 hours.
Nail {mechanic.noun} first, then add {secondary*.noun}. One location, a few hours of play.
Build a vertical slice with {mechanic.noun} and {secondary*.noun}, then expand content once the loop sings.

Every system talks to every other system. Budget a decade, a publisher and a therapist.
